title.narrative: COMMUNITIES AND JAGUAR COEXISTENCE IN WESTERN MEXICO UNDER THE IMPACTS OF COVID19

description.narrative: The Western region of Mexico hold 9% of the jaguar population in the country which faces threats such as retaliatory killings, poaching for the illegal wildlife trade, hunting of prey, and habitat fragmentation. This project builds upon the successful work implemented by FONNOR since 2017 and funded by the Mexico program, by increasing the project coverage area to 40,000 hectares and integrating cost-efficient cattle management practices and technology. Furthermore, the project will fortify regional resilience against the pandemic effects, such as loss of ecotourism income because of COVID-19 and climate change. Funding from the Service will allow FONNOR, AC to implement the following jaguar and COVID19 recovery measures: i) close the knowledge-gap of 27 community biodiversity monitoring brigades trained during the 2017-2020 funding period; ii) conduct jaguar monitoring follow-up and data analysis training workshops for the monitoring brigades; iii) organize a regional photo.trapping contest as a financial incentive to ranchers committed to the conservation of jaguars and their habitat but affected by the loss of eco-tourism income due to COVID19; iv) provide technical assistance to ranchers to ensure the proper implementation of best land and cattle management practices, as a way to prevent retaliatory killings and ensure habitat connectivity; v) organize regional and national jaguar coexistence exchange of experiences workshops for cattle ranchers from all over Mexico; vi) conduct a regional assessment to characterize human-jaguar conflict in the area, evaluate the effectiveness of FONNORs previous interventions, and fine-tune current approaches; vii) establish a Community Environmental Education Collective with youngsters to carry out outreach and education activities in their communities; viii) design and distribute a biodiversity guide of the Jaguar western corridor; and ix) increase the level of knowledge and awareness of the people and visitors of Puerto V
